video_title: Davion Mitchell Miami Heat Pregame Media Availability | Heat vs. Mavericks | October 26, 2026

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on his increased three-point shooting volume
quotes.excerpt: I put in a lot of work this offseason, just working on my shot, my mental side of shooting.
quotes.quote: I put in a lot of work this offseason, just working on my shot, my mental side of shooting. Honestly, I'm not looking at the percentages. I'm looking at if I shoot it, I just need to shoot it. That's my mindset. I'm not really looking at the misses or makes because one day it can go in, one day it couldn't. I just look at the work that I put in and trust in it.

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on early season learning and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Just because we're losing doesn't mean that it's anything surprising. It's preseason, so everyone doesn't play their regular minutes.
quotes.quote: Just because we're losing doesn't mean that it's anything surprising. It's preseason, so everyone doesn't play their regular minutes. The rotations are different, people's rhythm is a little bit different, the coaching style is a little bit different. I didn't look at preseason since we won all those games that we should start off really good. I think that we're just learning. We're learning from one another and it's good that we're doing it right now.

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on adjusting to playing with Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: You got to expect with someone like Giannis Antetokounmpo, one of the greatest players in the league, it's going to look different.
quotes.quote: You got to expect with someone like Giannis Antetokounmpo, one of the greatest players in the league, it's going to look different than what we did last year. The way we play is going to look a little bit different because he's one of the greatest players in the league. People got to figure out how to find a rhythm with him, and I think people are. We got to get used to it, and I'm looking forward to when we actually show up and shine and play our best that we're going to look really good.

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on the importance of rhythm and confidence in shooting
quotes.excerpt: If I make my first four shots, I'm going to shoot the next one and I have no doubt.
quotes.quote: If someone has a rhythm and they're comfortable and they're shooting the ball, I think a lot of people put work in the offseason to make those shots. They're shooting the shots that they're supposed to. We're just getting closer to them. We got to make them think a little bit. It's easy when if I make my first four shots, I'm going to shoot the next one and I have no doubt. I think that's what it is when teams make their first four shots, everyone has confidence, people have rhythm, and those shots go in.

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on balancing individual and team defensive responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: I always been a good individual defender, so I had to figure out how to play team defense.
quotes.quote: I always been a good individual defender, so I always played good defense. I'm year six in the league right now, so I had to figure out how to play team defense and I think I'm getting better and better each year. Just playing off the ball, I got to talk a little bit more, and we just got to have a sense of urgency going in and not letting people get comfortable. I think sometimes we disrespect people because they don't have a quote-unquote name, and that's when they get rhythm, that's when they get momentum, and that's when it's hard to stop.

quotes.speaker: Davion Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell on controlling the game against NBA-caliber talent
quotes.excerpt: They are NBA players too, just like us, and they're going to make tough shots.
quotes.quote: They are NBA players too, just like us, and they're going to make tough shots. They're going to make shots. Sometimes someone is going to score 40. Sometimes you can't really control as much your game because people make shots and they're the best players in the world for a reason. I think we got to do a better job of letting the relief points, the second chances, the rebounding, and when they get extra shots, now it's a little bit trickier because now they get more possessions than us.
